imageQa.note: Intentional image-free editorial layouts. The mattress guide uses exact-category Amazon text links only; no editorial, affiliate or product image is added or changed.

searchConsole.signal: BeautifulMensClub.com recorded 412 impressions, zero clicks, 0% CTR and average position 28.24. The submitted-sitemap snapshot still reported 212 URLs while the pre-publication repository sitemap contained 272 canonical URLs, a material discovery lag with no reported sitemap error or warning.
searchConsole.decision: No page is labeled Data-led because no query or page cluster had repeatable, decision-grade volume. The discovery signal instead shaped the work: three unrelated evergreen pages are exposed from the homepage, Library and relevant department hubs, reinforced by twelve reciprocal contextual links and added to a regenerated 275-URL sitemap.
searchConsole.ignored: One impression for ‘beard system’ at position 4, three combined impressions for two CDC jet-lag queries at positions 7–8, one public-Wi-Fi impression at position 19 and four capsule-wardrobe impressions at position 9 were deliberately ignored as too small, already served or unrelated to this batch.

monetization.placement: Three disclosed sponsored/nofollow exact-category text links appear only on the mattress guide: innerspring, foam and hybrid mattress categories. Readers are told to verify dimensions, materials, model label, foundation compatibility, seller, delivery, trial and return terms. The heart-rate and museum guides remain commerce-free.

authority.action: Created a citation-ready exercise heart-rate interpretation table and session record that separates resting context, manual or device measurement, estimated training ranges, talk test, perceived effort, symptoms and stop rules, with direct CDC, HHS, AHA and FDA source routes.
authority.cluster: Fitness now connects heart-rate interpretation to the talk test, fitness-device selection, warm-up planning and doctor-visit handoff. Life connects mattress specification to sleep systems, pajamas, guest-room readiness and large-item delivery, while the museum guide connects art care, conversation and public-event etiquette.
authority.opportunity: American Heart Association public-information team — https://www.heart.org/en/about-us/contact-us — Asset match: a commerce-free field record that frames age-predicted heart-rate ranges as estimates and cross-checks them with talk test, perceived effort and symptoms. Honest angle: invite factual corrections and usability review only; never imply AHA review or endorsement. No outreach was sent.

diversity: The batch answers three distinct questions across Fitness and Life: how to buy a mattress that fits the complete room-and-return system; how to interpret exercise heart rate without treating one number as a diagnosis or prescription; and how to plan an attentive museum visit without violating venue or collection rules. The mattress guide serves high purchase intent, the heart-rate record expands an established fitness-intensity cluster, and the museum field guide explores an underserved taste-and-culture problem. Analytics shaped discovery architecture rather than topic selection because its query samples were too weak.
